review_notes: I read the whole file. I searched Mathlib for existing pi/quotient constructions, using patterns like quotientPi, piQuotient, and pi/quot name combinations. The nearest matches were Setoid.piQuotientEquiv (a plain Equiv of setoid quotients, with no module structure), Ideal.quotientInfRingEquivPiQuotient and quotientInfToPiQuotient (ring quotients of an intersection, a different statement), and Factors.piQuotientLinearEquiv. None of these is the quotient of a Pi module by Submodule.pi compared with the Pi of quotients. The main uses are in FreeModule/Finite/Quotient.lean, which calls Submodule.quotientPi. Both lift definitions (piQuotientLift and quotientPiLift) are thin named wrappers over lsum/mapQ and liftQ/LinearMap.pi, and the rubric says such wrappers are not defects. I found no competing duplicate concept, so I am abstaining.
